name: NIST beam neutron lifetime experiment BL2
notes: The "BL2 collaboration" is named in the 2025 paper; a BL2 lifetime result has not been published in the sources consulted.

physics_goals.quote: The data in this period were part of studies re-examining systematic effects associated with beam experiments using this technique.
physics_goals.value: Re-examine the systematic effects of the beam method of measuring the neutron lifetime

summary.plain: The second NIST beam neutron-lifetime experiment, using largely the same apparatus as the first to study systematic effects. Its 2018-2020 data led to a 2025 study of how molecular hydrogen in the vacuum could affect such measurements; no BL2 lifetime has been reported.
summary.technical: BL2 at the NCNR: cold-neutron-beam proton-trap lifetime apparatus, largely the same as that used in 2003, used for re-examination of beam-method systematics; 2025 paper demonstrates charge exchange of trapped protons on molecular hydrogen and its detection efficiency, concluding BL1 was unlikely to be significantly affected.
